record.body:
## Problem

The repo still tracks the store files, and the docs, hooks, CI and worktrees assume the file layout.

## Approach

Run the cutover runbook on `phase/cutover`: export, verify, import, flip the config and binding, untrack the files, delete the file backend, wire the backup hook, and rewrite the docs and CI. Settled by the user. Decisions: `canon-ci-store-check`, `canon-old-history`. Plan-phase may split the switch from the cleanup.

## Exit criteria

- R1 to R18 of the specification pass. Verified by the tests, the command runs in the specification, and a CI run observation.
- `git ls-files .canon` lists only config, binding and schemas. Verified by running it.
- Full CI passes on a pushed branch. Verified by a CI run observation.

## Proof

kind: mixed. A human runs two agent sessions in two worktrees that write records at the same time, then runs `canon validate` and `git status`. Both sessions see each other's records, and `git status` shows no store change.

payload.title: Switch this repo to the DB and untrack the files
